title: Ukholo Olungemuva Kwesihlalo Sobukhosi
intro: Eminye imiphefumulo ayivivinywa ngomlilo noma ngesikhukhula, kodwa ngokucindezela okuhamba kancane kokuphila esigodlweni sombusi oyisihluku. Lesi sibalo sasimi eceleni kombusi owayethi unguNkulunkulu phezu kwabantu bakhe, kodwa ebambelele ngasese okholweni kuNkulunkulu Oyedwa Weqiniso. Lapho ukuzinikela kwabo kutholakala, kwafika ukuhlupheka - kodwa nesithembiso saphezulu safika. Ungaqagela ukuthi ngubani lo?
clues: Bengihlala ngaphansi kophahla lombusi onamandla kakhulu ezweni lakithi, esimweni abambalwa ababengasicabanga.
Umlingani wami wema phambi kwabantu futhi wazibiza ngokuthi ungunkulunkulu — kodwa inhliziyo yami yayingeyeNkosi Eyodwa Yeqiniso.
Ngahlebela imithandazo ngasese, ngesaba isijeziso esasizofika kubo bonke abamdelelayo umlingani wami.
Lapho ukholo lwami ludalulwa, ngabanjwa futhi ngahlushwa — kodwa ulimi lwami aluzange lukhulume izwi lokungakholwa.
Ngathulula inhliziyo yami eNkosini yami, ngicela indlu ePharadesi, kude nazo zonke izenzo ezimbi.
Ngingu-Asiya bint Muzahim — umkaFaro owayephikisana noMusa noHarun.

outcome.label: Umphumela
options: Bacwila ngaphansi kwamagagasi kanye nebutho labo
Washiswa emalangabini kodwa wasindiswa ukungenelela kukaNkulunkulu
Wagwinywa yisidalwa esikhulu wabe esephonswa ogwini
Waba ngumuntu ocebile kunabo bonke ngesikhathi sakhe

arabic: وَضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ فِرْعَوْنَ إِذْ قَالَتْ رَبِّ ٱبْنِ لِى عِندَكَ بَيْتًۭا فِى ٱلْجَنَّةِ وَنَجِّنِى مِن فِرْعَوْنَ وَعَمَلِهِۦ وَنَجِّنِى مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verse: And Allāh presents an example of those who believed: the wife of Pharaoh, when she said, "My Lord, build for me near You a house in Paradise and save me from Pharaoh and his deeds and save me from the wrongdoing people." (66:11)
